stories.headline: Federal judge rules AI license plate scan violated Fourth Amendment
AI created 750,000 new US jobs since 2023 at 180K median salary
SpaceX docked at ISS in record 7 hours 55 minutes
Starlink now live on 500-plus United Airlines flights
US debt crossed 100 percent of GDP for first time since World War 2

caption:
Here's what happened in AI and tech in the last 24 hours, from a court ruling against AI surveillance to 750,000 new jobs created by AI in the US 👇

A federal judge ruled a Tulsa sheriff's deputy violated a woman's Fourth Amendment rights by using Flock Safety's AI license plate scanner to track her, no warrant.
AI has created 750,000+ new US jobs since 2023, per LinkedIn. Data annotators lead at 282,000 new roles. Median AI salary: $180,000.
SpaceX set a US record, Dragon docked at the ISS in 7 hours and 55 minutes with four Crew-13 astronauts. NASA called it the fastest US spacecraft docking in ISS history.
United Airlines now runs Starlink on 500+ planes. One passenger streamed 5 live college football games at once from a single exit row.
US national debt crossed 100% of GDP for the first time since World War 2.

Courts, jobs, and debt, AI is in all of it now. The law is only just starting to catch up to what the tools can already do. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Flock Safety court ruling, LinkedIn, NASA, SpaceX, US Treasury.
